attractions.name: Interlaken Castle
attractions.description: Interlaken Castle (former Augustinian monastery) is a historic architectural gem in the town center, featuring a Gothic cloister and 14th-century chapel, exceptional for its medieval significance and charming grounds
attractions.entry_fee: Access to the castle grounds is free

attractions.description: Boat ride featuring Spiez Castle, vineyards, Niesen mountain

attractions.name: Lake Brienz Cruise
attractions.description: Scenic boat cruise across Lake Brienz with striking turquoise waters surrounded by waterfalls, alpine villages, and steep mountain cliffs.
attractions.entry_fee: Included with Swiss Travel Pass (or approx. ₹3,300–5,200 without pass)

attractions.name: Harder Kulm
attractions.description: Panoramic viewpoint above Interlaken offering breathtaking views over both Lake Thun and Lake Brienz with the Jungfrau mountain range in the background. Features a famous glass viewing platform.
attractions.entry_fee: Funicular ticket approx. INR 3,500–5,000 (discounts with Swiss Pass)

attractions.name: Jungfraujoch – Top of Europe
attractions.description: Perched at 3,454 meters, offering panoramic views of the Aletsch Glacier. Features Ice Palace (glacier tunnels with ice sculptures), Sphinx Observatory (one of Europe's highest observation decks), and open snow plateau.

attractions.name: Höhematte Park
attractions.description: Wide green meadow surrounded by dramatic mountain peaks with colorful paragliders often floating overhead. On clear days, the Jungfrau mountain appears in the distance.
